# archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_exclusions (Resource)

Authoritative exclusions from one MCP gateway's Auto skill publication. Exclusions persist while Auto mode is disabled. Declare one per gateway; destroy clears exclusions while preserving the gateway and its publication policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Auto publication excludes these skills. The exclusion set persists while Auto
# mode is disabled; destroy clears it while preserving the publication policy.
resource "archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_exclusions" "restricted" {
  gateway_id         = archestra_mcp_gateway.operations.id
  excluded_skill_ids = [archestra_skill.restricted.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `excluded_skill_ids` (Set of String) Skill UUIDs excluded from Auto publication; an empty set clears all exclusions.
- `gateway_id` (String) MCP gateway UUID from archestra_mcp_gateway.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `gateway_id` — the exclusion list has no id of its own

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by MCP gateway UUID.
terraform import archestra_mcp_gateway_skill_exclusions.restricted 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
